item.title: Florida measles cases: Doctors explain what it means for the community after confirming St. Pete case
item.description: Health department officials are closely monitoring the first confirmed case of measles in St. Petersburg after a student at a local high school tested positive for the highly contagious virus.St. Petersburg Catholic High confirmed this week that a sophomore student has the disease. The school notified parents that the student has not been on campus since January 27, and so far, officials are unaware of any additional cases within the student body.
